_HELP: All options and examples: MenuLayout_README.md (same folder). Units = px at 1440p. Saves apply live.
_perf: true = every 5 s, write frame times and the plugin's own time per system to the log ([Perf] lines). README: perf.
_profileGame: true = time the game's own map/asset loading and log slow frames and area changes ([GameProf] lines). Read at game start: restart to switch. README: profileGame.
_cleanup: The game forces a full memory clean-up after battles, menus and map changes (~0.5 s of freeze each). skipGcCollect: skip the forced collection. unloadEveryMinutes: let the unused-asset sweep run at most this often; 0 = game's behaviour. Live. README: cleanup.
_kupoTextureCache: true = keep a graphics-card copy of KupoUI's full-texture replacements (title background, battle sprites) and reuse it on every menu load. false = KupoUI's normal behaviour. Live. README: kupoTextureCache.
_kupoFastUnreadable: true = do KupoUI's swap for the game's locked UI textures ourselves: same image, files kept in memory, without its step that always fails (~0.3 s faster per return to the title, ~0.6 s on the bestiary). false = KupoUI's own way. Live. README: kupoFastUnreadable.
_characterNames: Party names come from the save file, so a text pack only renames them in new games. Saved name -> name shown. README: characterNames.
_textStyles: Style for every text of a font type. README: textStyles.

screens.name: equip select
screens._comment: Equip screen, choosing an item: the character in the right box (the 'equip' rule made it overlap the item names). Must stay above 'equip' (first match wins). height 300 + top 398 keeps the feet where they were (698).

_battle: spritesDown: party, enemies and effects move down this many px (1440p); background stays. Live. README: battle.
_renderHeights: Battle/field render resolution. 0 = game's own size. README: renderHeights.
_loadingIcon: Frames: PNGs in the loading_icon folder, in name order. size 0 = game's size. priority: Low/BelowNormal/Normal/High while loading, "" = game's. README: loadingIcon.
_titleHighlight: Title menu: the cursor item / mouse-hover item fades to this colour and grows. Delete the block to turn it off. README: titleHighlight.
_styles: Shared named styles. A rule with "style": "name" (or ["a", "b"]) gets these keys; its own keys win; selected/greyed/shadow/outline/backdrop merge key by key. README: styles.

screen name._comment: Character name at the top of a screen.

list row._comment: Rows in item lists: name, colon and quantity.

_elements: Texts, images, sprites. Find paths with F8 (screen dump). README: elements.
